_comment: Harness-level enforcement of the research contract. Per owner directive 2026-07-24:
'OUR RESEARCH IS INVALID IF IT IS NOT COMPLIANT WITH OUR GOVERNANCE AND VERIFICATION
WHY HOOKS AND NOT PROSE: the 2026-07-24 research run skipped Co-1, citation mining, clause
citation and combinatorial pairing while the rules for all four sat documented in skills/,
governance/ and CLAUDE.md. The rules did not fail; PROSE failed — an agent must choose to
load it, and attention degrades as context fills. Hooks run at the HARNESS level: they fire
on every session regardless of what any agent has read or remembers.
SessionStart re-injects the contract at the top of every session (before context fills).
Stop runs the mechanical definition-of-done gate so a session cannot quietly end
non-compliant. Neither blocks work; both make non-compliance impossible to not-see.
_permissions_comment: scripts/migrate_db.py is the ONLY sanctioned writer of data/guidebook.db (CLAUDE.md
rule 3: 'Never write data/guidebook.db directly. Migrations only.'). Every research
batch ends there — scratch copy -> db.py -> emit_batch_sql.py -> emit_data_migration.py
-> migrate_db.py — so without this rule no batch, and no ratification, can land.
It is allowed rather than prompted because the script is itself the safety mechanism:
it applies migrations forward-only inside one transaction, stamps user_version and the
data_migrations ledger atomically with the DDL, and rolls back as a unit on failure.
Blanket shell access is NOT granted — the two rules below name one script and nothing

hooks.command: printf '%s\n' '================ GUIDEBOOK RESEARCH CONTRACT (harness-injected) ================' 'RESEARCH IS INVALID IF NOT COMPLIANT WITH OUR GOVERNANCE, VERIFICATION TOOLS,' 'RULES AND ETHOS. Compliance is mechanical, not remembered.' '' 'BEFORE admitting evidence:' '  R1  Co-1 / T2 / Co-2 pass FIRST - no exceptions (Co-1 co-primary w/ T1, CRPD' '      4.3)' '  R5  Non-English peer-reviewed work is ACADEMIC, not grey. Non-indexation in' '      PubMed/Scopus is an INDEXING fact, not an evidence-quality fact.' '  R9  Pre-check the DOI. If it exists, cross-file the existing ref_id - never' '      duplicate.' '  R10 Re-retrieve every locator. DOI -> Crossref/PubMed -> publisher ->' '      repository. A publisher block is NOT a terminal answer. No re-retrieval' '      = no admission.' '' 'WHILE searching:' '  R2  Mine every CONFIRMED T1-T2 anchor backward AND forward. Depth 2-3 via' '      citation-miner; gap-driven mode is depth-1 per pass and hands off.' '  R4  Cross slug x population / access-need / ICF / axis. Cells are (item x' '      population).' '  R7  Capture FAILURE / HARM / INADEQUACY as first-class evidence, not a' '      by-product.' '  R8  Log EVERY query verbatim before screening, WITH --prior-expectation' '      written BEFORE you run it - a prior recorded after seeing results is a' '      rationalisation, not a prior (DR-2026-05-09). KEEP EMPTIES - a' '      zero-yield search is a COMPLETED unit of work. Never delete or backfill' '      them.' '  R13 Grade population-of-STUDY vs population-SERVED on every admission. No' '      match row = silently claiming they are the same.' '      Children/general-population/no-participants = PROXY.' '  R14 A zero-yield search is evidence of ABSENCE only if the query was' '      well-formed. PubMed AND-chains every term: say query-shape failure vs' '      wrong index vs genuine absence.' '' 'WHEN filing:' '  R3  Quantified values need a locator or [UNVERIFIED-QUANT]. Code/standard' '      values: clause/section/page. Outcome claims: DOI + page/table, or a' '      direct URL.' '  R6  Findings go in findings_note. deferred_reason means DELIBERATELY NOT' '      SEARCHED.' '  R7  Off-slug or unverified material -> search_candidates' '      (REHOME/MISC/PENDING), not prose.' '  R11 No back-translation. Every alias carries its in-language source, else' '      [UNVERIFIED-TERMS]. HARVEST AS YOU GO: db.py observe-term for each' '      concept phrase a source USES, in the source'\''s own words. That is a fact' '      about the document, not a claim it names one of our categories; judgment' '      adjudicates it later (D-0173).' '  R12 Case studies -> case_studies. Economics -> economics_entries. Code' '      values -> research_code_leads. Never leave them in prose notes.' '  R15 A staged candidate description is a HYPOTHESIS. On resolution,' '      re-describe it from the source and CORRECT it if you over-claimed. Do' '      not let your own guess harden into fact.' '' 'ALWAYS: migrations-only (emit_data_migration -> migrate_db). Never hand-edit the DB.' 'Never author best_practice_synthesis below the Opus floor. Never move an adjudicated figure.' 'Gate before you claim done:  python3 scripts/audit/research_batch_dod.py --session <id>' '==============================================================================='

if [ -f scripts/audit/research_batch_dod.py ] && [ -f data/guidebook.db ]; then out=$(python3 scripts/audit/research_batch_dod.py --all 2>&1); rc=$?; printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -n 20; if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then echo "RESEARCH DoD: PASS (exit 0)"; else echo "RESEARCH DoD: FAIL (exit $rc) — non-blocking by design, but this session closed non-compliant. See governance/research-contract.yaml."; fi; fi
